messages:
noah: Customer reported getting provisional + final tokens when a stream failed over. Looks like fallback route wrote a provisional row and later commit didn't dedupe.

riley: Can you paste trace?

noah: short log:
```
2026-04-12T11:02:01Z INFO session=aaa route=primary emit=prefix(60) provisional=60 tool=tc-9
2026-04-12T11:02:02Z WARN session=aaa fallback=region2
2026-04-12T11:02:03Z INFO session=aaa route=region2 committed=1 tool=tc-9 confirmed=145
```

sara: Quick mitigation: hide provisional rows in hosted billing UI and add hover text explaining adjustments.

riley: Longer fix: collapse provisional by (session_id, toolcall_id) unless client supplies attempt_id. Also emit token.prov.reconciled event.

ops-bot: INF-5601 created and linked.

noah: I'll draft the console change and a CS blurb.
